title: My Dog Max
text:
I have a dog. His name is Max. He is brown and white. He has a long tail and small ears.

Max is very friendly. He likes to play with his ball in the park. He is not big, but he is fast. I love my dog.

questions.text: Where does Max like to play?
How does the writer feel about Max?
options: The writer is afraid of Max.
The writer does not know Max.
The writer is angry with Max.

questions.text: Why is Max probably a good pet?
options: He is very big and loud.
He is friendly and likes to play.

vocabulary.definition: kind and pleasant to be with
a public area with grass and trees where people can relax
the long part at the back of an animal's body
a round object used in games

paragraph_translations: У мене є собака. Його звати Макс. Він коричнево-білий. У нього довгий хвіст і маленькі вуха.
Макс дуже дружній. Він любить грати зі своїм м'ячем у парку. Він не великий, але він швидкий. Я люблю свого собаку.
